exact_small.scope: Every Boolean function in dimensions 1 through 4; all nonzero directions; d=1 and d=2.

robust_small.scope: Every f, nonzero v, and degree-at-most-two q in dimensions 1 through 3; exact Hamming errors.

tree_checks.scope: 32 seeded affine-scrambled high-degree cores plus cubic phases, and 4 affine roots, in dimensions 5 through 8.

approximate_symmetry.scope: Every f, direction, constant phase, and supported pivot in dimensions 1 through 3, with error <=1/2.

gluing_counterexample.inequality_refuted: Delta(shared product) <= Delta(first factor) + Delta(second factor)
gluing_counterexample.interpretation: Counterexample to the proposed gluing inequality, NOT to FEI.

compression_constant.interpretation: Existing local entropy-payment bound used in the new directional compression theorem; not a new universal FEI constant.
